name: peerloop-backend
description: Backend server for the PeerLoop application

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:server && node dist/scripts/setup.js && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:frontend && tsc -p smart-contract/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build:server && npm run build:frontend && node --test dist/tests/backend/config.test.js dist/tests/backend/app.test.js dist/tests/backend/contractListener.test.js dist/tests/backend/ipRateLimiter.test.js dist/tests/backend/modules/auth/auth.test.js dist/tests/backend/modules/listing-metadata/listingMetadata.test.js dist/tests/backend/modules/public-config/publicConfig.test.js dist/tests/backend/modules/uploads/uploads.test.js dist/tests/frontend/accountDashboard.test.js dist/tests/frontend/apiClient.test.js dist/tests/frontend/checkout.test.js dist/tests/frontend/money.test.js
scripts.test:abi: npm run build:server && npm run build:frontend && node --test dist/tests/contracts/abiParity.test.js
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:config && npm run typecheck:browser-boundaries
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:abi && npm run test:abi && npm test && npm run test:contracts && npm run build
scripts.build:frontend: tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.cjs -i frontend/tailwind.css -o frontend/dist/css/tailwind.css --minify && tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.json && tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.app.json && esbuild frontend/src/client/app.tsx --bundle --format=esm --splitting --platform=browser --target=es2020 --jsx=automatic --outdir=frontend/dist --entry-names=app --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash]
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build && nodemon --watch backend --ext ts --exec "npm run build:server && node ./dist/backend/server.js"
